edgeInstall: In Edge, choose Get and approve adding Codeclub Browser Control.
manualInstall: Choose Load unpacked and select the Codeclub Browser Control folder that opened.
uninstall: Remove Codeclub Browser Control from the browser extensions page.
help: Edge: Install opens Microsoft Edge Add-ons. Uninstall opens the extension for removal. Other browsers use manual loading. Connected confirms the companion responds to Codeclub.
